sc.tour.help.label: Help
sc.tour.help.heading: Guided tours
sc.tour.welcome.title: Welcome to your back office
sc.tour.welcome.summary: A quick look around, and what your application status means.
sc.tour.welcome.hello.title: Welcome, here is a quick look around
sc.tour.welcome.hello.body: This takes about a minute. Use the Next button or the arrow keys. You can stop any time with Esc or Skip tour, and replay it later from the Help menu.
sc.tour.welcome.menu.title: Your menu
sc.tour.welcome.menu.body: Everything you can open is listed here. If something is missing, your role does not include it. Ask the owner of your business to change your role.
sc.tour.welcome.business.title: Your business and where it stands
sc.tour.welcome.business.body: The line under your business name shows your application status: in progress, in review, needs information, or approved. If you work for more than one business, switch between them here.
sc.tour.welcome.application.title: Your application
sc.tour.welcome.application.body: This page shows what is done and what happens next. We email you when something changes. Until you are approved, only the application is open.
sc.tour.welcome.steps.title: Your application steps
sc.tour.welcome.steps.body: Work through the steps in order. Your answers are saved as you go, so you can leave and come back. A step marked with a warning needs your attention.
sc.tour.welcome.home.title: Home, your day at a glance
sc.tour.welcome.home.body: Each area you work in has a short summary and quick buttons. Use the period picker to look at the last 7, 30 or 90 days.
sc.tour.welcome.help.title: Need this again?
sc.tour.welcome.help.body: Open Help, then the Tour hub, whenever you want a reminder. There is a short chapter for each part of your back office, and you can pick up where you left off.
sc.tour.firstProduct.title: Create your first product
sc.tour.firstProduct.summary: Search for your product by name, add details and photos if it is new, and send it for review.
sc.tour.firstProduct.add.title: Start with Add a product
sc.tour.firstProduct.add.body: Your turn: select this button. You start by typing what you are selling, then add the details, and your work is saved as a draft as you go.
sc.tour.firstProduct.search.title: Type what you are selling
sc.tour.firstProduct.search.body: Type the name, with the size or pack: for example, basmati rice 5kg. No barcode is needed. We show the pages that look like it, with the photo and the number of sellers. Choose This is my product, confirm the size, and you add only your price and stock. Not there? Select Not here, add it as new. Have a barcode? Use I have a barcode for an exact match.
sc.tour.firstProduct.offerOnly.title: If the product already has a page
sc.tour.firstProduct.offerOnly.body: You add only your price, quantity and condition. The photos, title and details stay as they are, because they belong to the page, and you can suggest a change if something is wrong. Your listing may wait for a quick tax check, and you will see “We are checking the tax details for this item” until it is done.
sc.tour.firstProduct.carryOn.title: New product? Carry on to the form
sc.tour.firstProduct.carryOn.body: If the product is new to AfroTransact, select Not here, add it as new. When the full form opens, this step shows Done: select Next and the steps after it walk through the form. If the product already has a page, finish adding your price and stock instead and you are done.
sc.tour.firstProduct.category.title: Pick the category first
sc.tour.firstProduct.category.body: Choose the most specific category you can find. It decides which questions come next, including the questions we use to work out tax. You never type a tax code.
sc.tour.firstProduct.photos.title: Add clear photos
sc.tour.firstProduct.photos.body: Show the front first, then the back, the label and any details. Good photos help shoppers trust your product.
sc.tour.firstProduct.missing.title: What is still missing
sc.tour.firstProduct.missing.body: This list shows what you still need to add and how complete your listing is. Select an item to jump to it.
sc.tour.firstProduct.submit.title: Send it for review
sc.tour.firstProduct.submit.body: When you send the listing, we check it before it goes live. Some products also need a quick tax check. If you see “We are checking the tax details for this item”, your listing is waiting for that check. You do not need to do anything unless we ask you for a document.
sc.tour.approvals.title: Selling approvals and what each status means
sc.tour.approvals.summary: Which products need our approval, and what each status means.
sc.tour.approvals.button.title: Some products need approval first
sc.tour.approvals.button.body: Some categories and brands, such as supplements or designer names, need our approval before they can go live. Open Selling approvals to see which ones apply to you.
sc.tour.approvals.find.title: Find your category or brand
sc.tour.approvals.find.body: Type a word to find what you sell. You apply once for a category or brand, and after that every listing there goes live without another check.
sc.tour.approvals.status.title: What each status means
sc.tour.approvals.status.body: Not applied: you can apply now. Applied: we are reviewing it. Needs attention: we need something from you, or it was not approved. Approved: you can sell here. Expired: renew to keep your listings live.
sc.tour.approvals.expiry.title: Documents that expire
sc.tour.approvals.expiry.body: We warn you 30, 14 and 7 days before a document expires. If it is not renewed 14 days after it expires, those listings are paused, never deleted, and they come back when your renewal is approved.
sc.tour.inventory.title: Stock and inventory
sc.tour.inventory.summary: Stock we hold for you and the stock you keep yourself.
sc.tour.inventory.page.title: Stock in one place
sc.tour.inventory.page.body: Here you see the stock AfroTransact holds for you after you send it to us. The tabs let you send more stock and follow lots and expiry dates. Stock you keep and ship yourself is set on each listing.
sc.tour.inventory.numbers.title: Read the numbers
sc.tour.inventory.numbers.body: Available is what can be sold now. Reserved is held for orders in progress. Inbound is on its way to us. Low-stock items are counted so you can restock early.
sc.tour.inventory.table.title: Stock by warehouse
sc.tour.inventory.table.body: Search by product code or warehouse. Items running low are easy to spot here.
sc.tour.inventory.count.title: Count your own stock
sc.tour.inventory.count.body: For items you ship yourself, set the number you really have. When someone orders, the number goes down. If you also sell somewhere else, such as in a shop, we cannot see those sales, so recount now and then and update the number here.
sc.tour.orders.title: Orders and shipping
sc.tour.orders.summary: Confirm, pack and ship an order, and hand over pickups.
sc.tour.orders.page.title: Your orders
sc.tour.orders.page.body: Orders you need to work on are here. Open any order to see the buyer, the items and the delivery details.
sc.tour.orders.table.title: Search, sort and move many at once
sc.tour.orders.table.body: Search by order number, buyer, item or tracking number. Tick several rows to move them to the next step together.
sc.tour.orders.next.title: One button, one next step
sc.tour.orders.next.body: Each order shows its next step: Confirm order, then Mark packed, then Mark ready to ship, then Mark shipped. Do each one when it is true, because the shopper sees the progress.
sc.tour.orders.pickup.title: When the shopper collects it
sc.tour.orders.pickup.body: For an order the shopper picks up from you, the last step is Hand over. Ask for the shopper’s code and enter it, so we know the right person has the order.
sc.tour.orders.tools.title: Pick lists and pickup settings
sc.tour.orders.tools.body: Delivery run pick lists show what to get ready for each delivery run. Ship-from & AfroTransact pickup is where you set your ship-from address and the hours when pickups can happen.
sc.tour.payouts.title: Payouts and your Stripe account
sc.tour.payouts.summary: How your money is held, requested and paid, and how to set up Stripe.
sc.tour.payouts.balance.title: Your balance in plain words
sc.tour.payouts.balance.body: Available is money you can ask for now. Still settling is money from orders that are not delivered yet. It is released after delivery, which protects shoppers and you if something goes wrong.
sc.tour.payouts.request.title: Ask for a payout
sc.tour.payouts.request.body: Press Request payout when the available amount reaches the minimum. You can ask once a day, and the money goes to the bank account you set up with Stripe.
sc.tour.payouts.tax.title: Sales tax statement
sc.tour.payouts.tax.body: Find the sales tax collected on your orders, by state and month. Keep it for your records or your accountant.
sc.tour.services.title: Your services
sc.tour.services.summary: Add services with prices and set where you work.
sc.tour.services.add.title: Add your services
sc.tour.services.add.body: Add each service with its price and how long it takes. Price changes apply to new bookings. Bookings already made keep the price that was agreed.
sc.tour.services.area.title: Where you work
sc.tour.services.area.body: Set your base address and how far you travel. Services that come to the customer are shown only to customers inside this distance. You can also add extra cities, ZIP codes or whole areas.
sc.tour.journey.setup.title: Get set up
sc.tour.journey.setup.summary: Your application, payments account, team and settings.
sc.tour.journey.catalogue.title: Products and stock
sc.tour.journey.catalogue.summary: Add products, photos and approvals, and keep stock right.
sc.tour.journey.fulfilment.title: Orders and delivery
sc.tour.journey.fulfilment.summary: Orders, where you ship from, pickups, returns and disputes.
sc.tour.journey.money.title: Money and growth
sc.tour.journey.money.summary: Your overview, payouts, fees, plan, coupons and reviews.
sc.tour.journey.services.title: Your services
sc.tour.journey.services.summary: Services, working hours, bookings and earnings for service providers.
sc.tour.ui.doItHint: Your turn: select the highlighted control. The tour moves on by itself.
sc.tour.hub.title: Tour hub
sc.tour.hub.description: Short guided tours of your back office, grouped into journeys. Start, resume, replay or skip any of them.
sc.tour.hub.intro: Each chapter takes a minute or two and only ever points things out; it never changes anything for you. Your progress is saved to your account, so it follows you to any browser or device.
sc.tour.hub.resetConfirm: Forget all your tour progress, here and in your other browsers and devices? Tours that start by themselves will start again.
sc.tour.hub.resetFailed: We could not reach the server, so nothing was reset. Try again in a moment.
sc.tour.hub.offline: We could not load your saved progress just now, so this page shows what this browser remembers. No tour starts by itself until it loads.
sc.tour.hub.autoOff: Tours do not start by themselves right now. You can still start any chapter here.
sc.tour.hub.empty: There are no tours for your role yet.
sc.tour.application.title: Your application
sc.tour.application.summary: Where your application stands and what happens next.
sc.tour.application.hello.title: Your application
sc.tour.application.hello.body: This page shows how your application is going. Most of your back office opens once it is approved.
sc.tour.application.status.title: Where you stand
sc.tour.application.status.body: Your status is here: in progress, in review, needs information or approved. We email you when it changes.
sc.tour.application.steps.title: Your steps
sc.tour.application.steps.body: Work through the steps in order. Your answers are saved as you go, and a warning mark means a step needs your attention.
sc.tour.application.after.title: After you send it
sc.tour.application.after.body: Our team reviews your application. If we need more, we ask for it here and by email, and you can answer from this page.
sc.tour.accountHealth.title: Account health and Stripe
sc.tour.accountHealth.summary: Whether shoppers can pay you and money can reach your bank, and how to fix it.
sc.tour.accountHealth.page.title: Your account health
sc.tour.accountHealth.page.body: This page tells you whether payments and payouts are on, and what to do if something needs attention.
sc.tour.accountHealth.status.title: What your account status means
sc.tour.accountHealth.status.body: Charges shows whether shoppers can pay you. Payouts shows whether money can go to your bank. Listings shows whether shoppers can see your products. A warning at the top says what to fix.
sc.tour.accountHealth.items.title: What is still outstanding
sc.tour.accountHealth.items.body: When Stripe needs something from you, it is listed here with where to answer and how urgent it is.
sc.tour.accountHealth.stripe.title: Set up or change your bank account
sc.tour.accountHealth.stripe.body: Stripe looks after the payment account for your business. Use the button here to answer what Stripe still needs, or to change your bank account, in Stripe’s secure forms. If something is missing, payouts can be paused until it is done.
sc.tour.team.title: Team and business page
sc.tour.team.summary: Invite people, give each the access they need, and edit your public page.
sc.tour.team.page.title: Your team
sc.tour.team.page.body: Here is where you see who works with you and what each person can do.
sc.tour.team.invite.title: Invite someone
sc.tour.team.invite.body: Send an invitation by email and choose a role. The person joins once they accept it.
sc.tour.team.people.title: Who has access
sc.tour.team.people.body: Each row shows a person, their role and whether they have joined. Give people the least access they need.
sc.tour.team.roles.title: Roles keep things safe
sc.tour.team.roles.body: A role decides which areas a person can open and whether they can change things or only look. If a menu entry is missing for someone, their role does not include it.
sc.tour.team.business.title: Your business page
sc.tour.team.business.body: The plain public page for your business: your logo, colour and what your business does. Shoppers see it, so keep it up to date.
sc.tour.accountSettings.title: My account and settings
sc.tour.accountSettings.summary: Your profile, sign-in security, alerts, language and display.
sc.tour.accountSettings.head.title: My account
sc.tour.accountSettings.head.body: These pages are about you, not your business: your details, how you sign in and how we reach you.
sc.tour.accountSettings.nav.title: Four sections
sc.tour.accountSettings.nav.body: Profile, Sign-in and security, Notifications and Preferences. Pick one to open it.
sc.tour.accountSettings.profile.title: Your profile
sc.tour.accountSettings.profile.body: Change your name, mobile number and job title, see the businesses you belong to and switch between them. A new mobile number is checked by text message.
sc.tour.accountSettings.security.title: Sign-in and security
sc.tour.accountSettings.security.body: Change your password, turn on two-step sign-in, add a passkey, and see where you are signed in so you can end sessions you do not recognise.
sc.tour.accountSettings.alerts.title: Alerts
sc.tour.accountSettings.alerts.body: Choose which alerts reach you by email or text, and set quiet hours. A few important alerts always stay on.
sc.tour.accountSettings.display.title: Language and display
sc.tour.accountSettings.display.body: Pick your language and time zone, how dates and numbers are written, and how roomy tables should be.
sc.tour.helpSupport.title: Help and support
sc.tour.helpSupport.summary: Where to find the tours, the assistant and the help centre.
sc.tour.helpSupport.hello.title: Help is always close
sc.tour.helpSupport.hello.body: Here are the places to look when you are stuck or want a reminder.
sc.tour.helpSupport.help.title: The Help menu
sc.tour.helpSupport.help.body: It opens the Tour hub, where every chapter shows your progress, and lets you resume the one you left. A small dot means a chapter has something new.
sc.tour.helpSupport.assistant.title: Ask the assistant
sc.tour.helpSupport.assistant.body: Lola can look at your orders, listings and stock and answer questions about your business. She never changes anything on her own: you confirm first.
sc.tour.helpSupport.wrap.title: The help centre
sc.tour.helpSupport.wrap.body: Your Home page ends with a short help section that links to the help centre. You can also start any chapter again from the Tour hub.
sc.tour.listings.title: Your listings
sc.tour.listings.summary: Find, price and manage everything you sell, and finish your drafts.
sc.tour.listings.page.title: Everything you sell
sc.tour.listings.page.body: Your listings are here. The Drafts tab holds forms you started and have not sent yet; they are saved as you type.
sc.tour.listings.actions.title: Add, import and approvals
sc.tour.listings.actions.body: Add a product, open Selling approvals, and, if your plan includes them, go to the image library or a bulk upload.
sc.tour.listings.table.title: Search, sort and change quickly
sc.tour.listings.table.body: Search by title or code, sort any column, and change a price or stock number right in the row. The row menu pauses or resumes a listing.
sc.tour.listings.status.title: What a status means
sc.tour.listings.status.body: Live listings can be bought. In review is being checked. Paused is hidden until you resume it. If a listing needs changes, open it and follow the note at the top.
sc.tour.productSections.title: Product details by category
sc.tour.productSections.summary: Price, barcode, tax questions, variations, sizes and fulfilment.
sc.tour.productSections.carryOn.title: Open the full form
sc.tour.productSections.carryOn.body: Add a product starts with a search box. Search for your product, then select Not here, add it as new to continue with a product that is new to AfroTransact. When the full form opens this step shows Done: select Next to see its sections. The category you choose decides which sections appear, so the form only asks what matters for your product. A product that already has a page needs only your price and stock.
sc.tour.productSections.basics.title: Category, title and description
sc.tour.productSections.basics.body: Pick the most specific category you can. If yours is missing, you can ask for it. Then write a clear title and description.
sc.tour.productSections.nav.title: Jump between sections
sc.tour.productSections.nav.body: This bar lists every section with what is still to do. Select one to go straight to it.
sc.tour.productSections.offer.title: Price, condition and barcode
sc.tour.productSections.offer.body: Set your price and, where it applies, the condition, your own product code and the barcode. If a product has no barcode, tick the box that says so.
sc.tour.productSections.facts.title: A few plain questions
sc.tour.productSections.facts.body: Some categories ask a few questions about the item, for example what it is made of or how it is sold. Answer them as they are. We use your answers to work out the tax for you, so you never type a tax code.
sc.tour.productSections.variants.title: Variations
sc.tour.productSections.variants.body: If the product comes in sizes, colours or other options, add a variation for each one with its own price and stock.
sc.tour.productSections.sizes.title: Size guide
sc.tour.productSections.sizes.body: For clothing and shoes, attach a size chart so shoppers pick the right size. You can make a chart once and reuse it on other products.
sc.tour.productSections.fulfilment.title: Who ships it
sc.tour.productSections.fulfilment.body: Choose whether you ship this product yourself or send the stock to an AfroTransact fulfilment centre. This changes where the stock count lives.
sc.tour.images.title: Product image library
sc.tour.images.summary: Upload photos once and attach them to your listings.
sc.tour.images.page.title: Your photo library
sc.tour.images.page.body: Upload many photos at once, or a ZIP of them. Photos are matched to your products by file name.
sc.tour.images.actions.title: Attach to listings
sc.tour.images.actions.body: When your photos are ready, press Attach to listings. Only listings that have new matching photos are updated.
sc.tour.images.library.title: What is in the library
sc.tour.images.library.body: Each photo shows whether it is linked to a product code or still waiting. Removing a photo here does not remove it from listings that already use it.
sc.tour.images.names.title: Name photos after your product codes
sc.tour.images.names.body: Name each file after the product code, for example SKU123.jpg, then add a number or a word for extra angles. Bulk uploads and existing listings pick the photos up by name.
sc.tour.bulkUpload.title: Bulk upload and reports
sc.tour.bulkUpload.summary: Add or update many products from a spreadsheet, and read each report.
sc.tour.bulkUpload.page.title: Add many products at once
sc.tour.bulkUpload.page.body: Use an Excel or CSV file to add or update products in one go. It is the fastest way when you have many.
sc.tour.bulkUpload.template.title: Start from a template
sc.tour.bulkUpload.template.body: Download the template for your category. It has a column for every detail it needs, with dropdowns, and columns marked with a star are required. For variations, use one row per variation.
sc.tour.bulkUpload.links.title: Photos and history
sc.tour.bulkUpload.links.body: These links open your photo library and the history of earlier uploads.
sc.tour.bulkUpload.history.title: Upload history
sc.tour.bulkUpload.history.body: Every file you uploaded is listed here with its date and result.
sc.tour.bulkUpload.reports.title: Open a report
sc.tour.bulkUpload.reports.body: Open an upload to see, row by row, what was added and what needs fixing. Fix those rows and upload again.
sc.tour.shippingSetup.title: Ship-from addresses and pickup
sc.tour.shippingSetup.summary: Where you ship from and when pickups can happen.
sc.tour.shippingSetup.page.title: Where you ship from
sc.tour.shippingSetup.page.body: Your ship-from addresses live here. Shipping and pickup settings are set for each address.
sc.tour.shippingSetup.actions.title: Add or go back
sc.tour.shippingSetup.actions.body: Add another address, or go back to your orders.
sc.tour.shippingSetup.address.title: An address and its position
sc.tour.shippingSetup.address.body: Each card shows an address. Make one the default, or edit it. Keep it correct, because it is where packages are collected or sent from.
sc.tour.shippingSetup.pickup.title: Pickup hours and customer pickup
sc.tour.shippingSetup.pickup.body: Set the hours when a package can be collected from this address. You can also let shoppers collect their order from you, and say how long you need to get it ready.
sc.tour.runPickups.title: Delivery run pick lists
sc.tour.runPickups.summary: What to get ready for each delivery run.
sc.tour.runPickups.page.title: Your pick lists
sc.tour.runPickups.page.body: When a delivery run is planned, it shows up here with the town and the time it is collected from you.
sc.tour.runPickups.about.title: Open a run to see what to pack
sc.tour.runPickups.about.body: Each run has its own list of orders and items to have ready. You can print it to take with you when you pack.
sc.tour.runPickups.back.title: Back to orders
sc.tour.runPickups.back.body: This button takes you back to the orders list when you are done.
sc.tour.returnsDisputes.title: Returns and disputes
sc.tour.returnsDisputes.summary: Items sent back, the refund each leads to, and claims you need to answer.
sc.tour.returnsDisputes.page.title: Returns
sc.tour.returnsDisputes.page.body: Items customers sent back from your orders are listed here, with the refund each one leads to.
sc.tour.returnsDisputes.filter.title: Filter by status
sc.tour.returnsDisputes.filter.body: Show only the returns in one status.
sc.tour.returnsDisputes.table.title: Each return in one row
sc.tour.returnsDisputes.table.body: Search, sort and open a row to see the order, the item and where it is in the return.
sc.tour.returnsDisputes.disputes.title: Disputes and claims
sc.tour.returnsDisputes.disputes.body: A customer can open a claim about an order. Each one shows the date you need to respond by, so check here often.
sc.tour.returnsDisputes.claims.title: Answer before the date
sc.tour.returnsDisputes.claims.body: Open a claim to read it and answer. Filter by status to find the ones still waiting for you.
sc.tour.dashboard.title: Home and reports
sc.tour.dashboard.summary: Your day at a glance, the period picker and the charts.
sc.tour.dashboard.page.title: Home
sc.tour.dashboard.page.body: Each area you work in has a short summary and quick buttons here. Things that need you are shown first.
sc.tour.dashboard.period.title: Pick the period
sc.tour.dashboard.period.body: Look at the last 7, 30 or 90 days. The numbers and charts follow your choice.
sc.tour.dashboard.reports.title: Reports
sc.tour.dashboard.reports.body: These charts show how your sales and orders are moving over the period you picked.
sc.tour.dashboard.tables.title: Search, sort and download
sc.tour.dashboard.tables.body: Most lists in your back office let you search, sort, choose columns and download what you see, so you can keep your own records.
sc.tour.payouts.history.title: Your payouts
sc.tour.payouts.history.body: Each payout you asked for is listed here with its amount, date and status.
sc.tour.payouts.statement.title: Read your monthly statement
sc.tour.payouts.statement.body: Pick a month to see the sales tax figures for your orders, by state, and download them as a file. It is a record for your own books; ask your accountant if you are unsure what to do with it.
sc.tour.feesBilling.title: Fees, plan and invoices
sc.tour.feesBilling.summary: What you are charged, your plan and your invoices.
sc.tour.feesBilling.page.title: What you are charged
sc.tour.feesBilling.page.body: This page lists the fees that apply to you: commission and other charges for what you sell.
sc.tour.feesBilling.rates.title: Where each rate comes from
sc.tour.feesBilling.rates.body: A rate can be negotiated for you, come with your plan, depend on the category, or be the standard one. The row tells you which.
sc.tour.feesBilling.table.title: Commission by category
sc.tour.feesBilling.table.body: Find your category to see the rate that applies to what you sell there.
sc.tour.feesBilling.plan.title: Your plan and billing
sc.tour.feesBilling.plan.body: See your current plan, when you are next charged and your credit balance, and change the plan if you need to.
sc.tour.feesBilling.invoices.title: Invoices
sc.tour.feesBilling.invoices.body: Every invoice for your plan is listed here so you can keep it for your records.
sc.tour.coupons.title: Coupons
sc.tour.coupons.summary: Discount codes for your own listings.
sc.tour.coupons.page.title: Your coupons
sc.tour.coupons.page.body: Create codes that give shoppers a discount on your listings, and see how each one is doing.
sc.tour.coupons.create.title: Make a new coupon
sc.tour.coupons.create.body: Choose a code, then a percentage off, a fixed amount off or free shipping. Nothing is created until you save.
sc.tour.coupons.table.title: Your codes
sc.tour.coupons.table.body: Every code you made is listed here with its discount and status.
sc.tour.coupons.scope.title: Your coupons, your listings
sc.tour.coupons.scope.body: A coupon you make only discounts your own listings. Sitewide promotions are run by AfroTransact and do not appear here.
sc.tour.reviews.title: Reviews
sc.tour.reviews.summary: What customers say, and how to reply.
sc.tour.reviews.page.title: Customer reviews
sc.tour.reviews.page.body: Reviews from customers who received your products are shown here, with their rating and any photos they shared.
sc.tour.reviews.filter.title: Find reviews waiting for a reply
sc.tour.reviews.filter.body: Switch between all reviews and the ones still waiting for your reply.
sc.tour.reviews.replies.title: One public reply
sc.tour.reviews.replies.body: You can reply once to each review, and everyone can read your reply. You cannot edit or hide a review, so keep your reply polite and helpful.
sc.tour.services.list.title: Your list of services
sc.tour.services.list.body: Every service you provide is listed here with its price and duration. Open one to change it.
sc.tour.availability.title: Working hours and cancellation policy
sc.tour.availability.summary: When customers can book you, and what happens if they cancel.
sc.tour.availability.hours.title: Your working hours
sc.tour.availability.hours.body: Customers only see times inside these hours, minus your bookings, the breaks between them and the dates you block. Block holidays and days off here.
sc.tour.availability.policy.title: Your cancellation policy
sc.tour.availability.policy.body: Pick a template or build your own. The policy you choose is applied automatically when a customer cancels.
sc.tour.availability.wrap.title: Keep both up to date
sc.tour.availability.wrap.body: Change them any time. New hours and policies apply to new bookings; bookings already made keep what was agreed.
sc.tour.bookings.title: Booking requests and calendar
sc.tour.bookings.summary: Answer new requests quickly and see every booking by day.
sc.tour.bookings.requests.title: Booking requests
sc.tour.bookings.requests.body: New requests wait here for your answer. A request expires after 4 hours and the deposit is released automatically, so reply quickly.
sc.tour.bookings.calendar.title: Your calendar
sc.tour.bookings.calendar.body: See every booking by day. Hover over a booking or day for a quick look, or click to open it.
sc.tour.bookings.wrap.title: Keep your hours honest
sc.tour.bookings.wrap.body: If you cannot take a booking, block the time in your working hours so customers do not request it.
sc.tour.providerEarnings.title: Earnings
sc.tour.providerEarnings.summary: What you earned from each booking and how it reaches your bank.
sc.tour.providerEarnings.page.title: Your earnings
sc.tour.providerEarnings.page.body: See what you earned over a period, and what is still settling before it can be paid out.
sc.tour.providerEarnings.table.title: Earnings by booking
sc.tour.providerEarnings.table.body: Each booking shows what the customer paid, what is taken out and what you keep.
sc.tour.providerEarnings.payouts.title: Ask for a payout
sc.tour.providerEarnings.payouts.body: Earnings settle for 7 days, then you can request a payout to your bank on the Payouts page.
sc.img.check.MAIN_TOO_SMALL: This photo is too small. The main photo must be at least {px} pixels on its longest side so shoppers can zoom. Yours is {w} by {h}.
sc.img.check.TOO_SMALL: This photo is too small. Use a photo that is at least {min} pixels wide and tall.
sc.img.check.LOW_RES: This photo is under {px} pixels, so shoppers cannot zoom in. A larger photo sells better.
sc.img.check.LARGER_BETTER: A photo of {px} pixels or more on its longest side zooms best.
sc.img.check.NOT_WHITE: The main photo needs a plain white background (pure white, RGB 255, 255, 255). Retake it or edit the background and upload it again.
sc.img.check.FILL_LOW: The product is too small in the photo. It should fill at least {fill}% of the height or width. Crop closer and upload again.
sc.img.check.FILL_OK_NEAR: The product could fill more of the photo. {fill}% or more looks best.
sc.img.check.BORDER: Remove the border or frame around the photo.
sc.img.check.PLACEHOLDER: This looks like a placeholder, not a photo of your product.
sc.img.check.FORMAT: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP file.
sc.img.check.FILE_TOO_BIG: This file is larger than {mb} MB. Save it at a smaller size.
sc.img.check.NOT_AN_IMAGE: This file is not a photo we can read.
sc.img.check.BLUR: This photo looks blurry. A sharper photo sells better.
sc.img.check.ASPECT: This photo is very wide or very tall. Square or close to square works best.
sc.img.check.HELD_TEXT: We are checking this photo for text, logos or watermarks. Main photos show the product only. We usually answer within 2 business days.
sc.img.check.HELD_MISMATCH: We are checking that this photo matches your product. We usually answer within 2 business days.
sc.img.check.HELD_DUPLICATE: We are checking this photo because it looks like one already used on AfroTransact.
sc.img.check.HELD_PROPS: We are checking this photo for props or people. The main photo shows the product only. We usually answer within 2 business days.
sc.img.check.HELD_REVIEW: We are checking this photo before it goes live. We usually answer within 2 business days.
sc.img.check.PROHIBITED: This photo cannot be used on AfroTransact.
sc.img.check.MAIN_PROPS: The main photo must show the product alone, without props or people. Use a photo of the product alone as the main photo.
sc.img.check.REVIEW_REJECTED: A reviewer did not approve this photo. Upload a different one.
sc.img.check.NOT_VERIFIED: We could not check this photo. Upload it again from your device or your image library.
sc.img.check.FETCH_FAILED: We could not get this photo from the link. Check that the link is public and starts with https.
sc.img.check.FETCH_PRIVATE: This link points to a private address, so we cannot use it.
sc.img.check.NO_MAIN_IMAGE: This listing has no main photo. Add one so shoppers can see the product.
sc.img.verdict.WARN: Ready, and it can be better
sc.pf.images.heldBlocks: Replace the main photo that was not accepted before you submit. A photo we are checking lets you submit, and the listing waits for our answer.
sc.img.task.title: Improve your image
sc.img.task.summaryImprove: The main photo of this listing works, and it could sell better.
sc.img.task.summaryFail: The main photo of this listing does not meet our photo rules yet.
sc.img.task.daysLeft: {n} days left to improve it before this listing may be limited in search and on the buy button.
sc.img.task.hidden: This listing is limited in search until you replace the main photo.
sc.img.task.home: {n} listings need a better main photo
sc.bulk.mode.OFFER.hint: Put your price and stock on products that are already on AfroTransact. You give the barcode, price and quantity; the photos and details are already there.
sc.bulk.mode.PRICE_QTY.hint: Change the price and quantity of your listings by SKU. A blank cell keeps what is there.
sc.bulk.mode.STOCK.hint: Send counts for the stock AfroTransact holds for you, by SKU and location.
sc.bulk.step1Hint.OFFER: One template for every category. Type the product name and its size or pack, with your price and quantity. A barcode or an ATIN, when you have one, is the surest way.
sc.bulk.step1Hint.PRICE_QTY: One template for every category. One row per SKU; leave a cell blank to keep what is there.
sc.bulk.step1Hint.STOCK: A CSV with one row per SKU and location. Choose whether the file holds counts or changes.
sc.bulk.stockMode.DELTA: A change to add or remove
sc.bulk.tip.OFFER.page: Name the product: its name with the size or pack (5 kg, 500 ml, 6 pack), and the brand and category if you know them. A barcode or an ATIN is an exact match. We link a row only when the product is exactly the same. If we are not sure, the row is held for you with the products we found.
sc.bulk.tip.OFFER.terms: Then give your price, quantity, condition, shipping charge and handling days.
sc.bulk.tip.OFFER.noPhotos: No photos, titles or details: the product page already has them. To add a new product, use Create new products.
sc.bulk.tip.OFFER.held: A row that needs a tax check or an approval waits On hold and is not for sale until it is cleared.
sc.bulk.tip.PRICE_QTY.keys: Use your Seller SKU: it is the key we use. The product’s ATIN works too. A barcode works only when it matches exactly one of your listings; if it matches more than one, use your SKU.
sc.bulk.tip.PRICE_QTY.blank: A blank cell keeps the current value, so you can change only prices or only quantities.
sc.bulk.tip.PRICE_QTY.own: Only your own listings change. A SKU that is not yours shows as unknown.
sc.bulk.tip.STOCK.columns: Columns: Seller SKU, Location, On hand (or Change), and Lot and Expiry for perishable items.
sc.bulk.tip.STOCK.reserved: A count cannot be lower than the units already reserved for orders, and never below zero.
sc.bulk.tip.STOCK.deltaOnce: A file of changes can only be applied once, so a second upload of it is not added again.
sc.bulk.err.csvOnly: A stock file must be a CSV (.csv) file. Save your spreadsheet as CSV and upload it again.
sc.bulk.limitsCsv: CSV · up to {mb} MB and {rows} rows
sc.bulk.uploadNoteStock: We check every row first: your stock does not change until you start the import.
sc.bulk.heldWhy.tax: We are checking the tax details for this item.
sc.bulk.heldWhy.approval: You need approval to sell this item. It stays on hold until you are approved.
sc.bulk.heldWhy.photo: We are checking a photo for this item.
sc.bulk.heldWhy.generic: This row is on hold and is not for sale yet.
sc.bulk.sameFile.title: You uploaded this file on {date}.
sc.bulk.sameFile.body: Show that result or run it again?
sc.bulk.allValidOffer: You are added as a seller of these products. Anything that needs a tax check or an approval waits On hold.
sc.bulk.allValidPriceQty: The prices and quantities of your listings are updated. Blank cells keep what is there.
sc.bulk.doneOffer: Import finished: {added, plural, one {# product added to your listings} other {# products added to your listings}}, {held} on hold.
sc.bulk.donePriceQty: Import finished: {updated, plural, one {# listing updated} other {# listings updated}}.
sc.bulk.doneOffers: {count, plural, one {# product added} other {# products added}}
sc.bulk.doneOffersChanged: {count, plural, one {# listing updated} other {# listings updated}}
sc.bulk.doneHeld: {count, plural, one {# row on hold} other {# rows on hold}}
sc.bulk.stock.allValid: {count, plural, one {Every row is ready: # row.} other {Every row is ready: # rows.}}
sc.bulk.stock.allValidABSOLUTE: Each SKU’s stock is set to the number in the file. Units already reserved for orders are never touched.
sc.bulk.stock.allValidDELTA: Each change is added to the stock. A file of changes is applied only once.
sc.bulk.stock.doneApplied: {count, plural, one {# row changed} other {# rows changed}}
sc.bulk.stock.doneUnchanged: {count, plural, one {# row already right} other {# rows already right}}
sc.bulk.stock.failed: The import stopped. Rows already changed stay; download the row report to see the rest.
sc.tour.bulkUpload.types.title: Choose what the file does
sc.tour.bulkUpload.types.body: Create new products, sell products already on AfroTransact, update prices and quantities, or update stock. Each one has its own template.
sc.pf.images.mainFirst: First photo is the main one
sc.pf.images.count: {count} of {max} photos · {extras} of {target} extra photos suggested
sc.pf.photo.short.fill: Product too small in the frame
sc.pf.photo.short.file: We could not use this file
